Buddy moderately elongated full dark torso, substantial real legs and visible clearance, modest head and projecting pale moustache, light brows, softly hanging ears, slender dark tail, regional furnishings only. Photo inputs 1-3 are primary visual anatomy evidence only in visible regions; fourth is generated provisional model/style interpretation, never stronger evidence than photographs.
